meta.about: Ascension (ascension.fyi) ranks consumer AI apps on one blended App Store and Google Play leaderboard, built from public store charts in 9 countries and updated daily at around 6 AM ET. Paid placements are always labeled and never change ranks. The data is free to reuse with credit under CC BY 4.0.
meta.citation: Data powered by Ascension (ascension.fyi), ranks as of Nov 8, 2026.
meta.notes: rank: position on the blended App Store + Google Play board of consumer AI apps. platform: ios, android, or ios+android. change: places moved since the previous day (positive = up), "new" if not on the previous board, null if there is no comparable previous day. date: the day in US Eastern time (YYYY-MM-DD).
